title: TAVI Desk has no page to see or edit a profile's permissions (TAVI Desk vs Zoho Desk)
label: BUG
env: TAVI Desk NDC-Staging · Settings › User Management › Profiles (admin account) · Zoho Desk test portal techsolutionsegypt · Setup › Profiles › Agent (read-only)

panels.caption: TAVI · Profiles: "Permissions live on the Profiles page", no Permissions item in User Management; the key icon is "View permissions on the Profiles page"
TAVI · after clicking the key icon: Desk Headquarters (/hq), no permissions
TAVI · Edit profile: only name, parent and rank; "Permissions stay editable on the Profiles page"
TAVI · the permissions exist in the API, but no Desk screen shows them
Zoho Desk · Setup › Profiles: each profile "Set the privileges for …"
Zoho Desk · Agent profile: Module, Tickets, Administrative and Multi-department permissions with toggles

rows: Where an admin sees a profile's permissions
No Permissions page in Desk settings; Profiles says "Permissions live on the Profiles page" but shows none
A full permissions page with toggles (Module, Tickets, Administrative, Multi-department)
"View permissions on the Profiles page" sends the admin to Desk Headquarters; /settings/security/permissions is not served in Desk
Edit profile changes only name, parent and rank
83 Desk permissions exist; the Desk Agent profile holds 52 — none can be seen or changed in Desk
